The pre-call estimate assumes the previous call's cache entry is read: a provider that drops an entry early, or a routed provider that moves a run to another credential mid-run (another workspace's cache, under 'use the other one'), can make one call cost up to cached x (write - read price) more than its estimate; the next call's estimate reads what happened. Documented in ADR 0112's amendment.

A retried task gives one live sample per try (onTaskFinished fires per executor call) but one summed sample after a restart (the fold sums the tries), as ADR 0019 designed; they agree for a task done in one try.
